Open-Source Bifrost Gateway
THEME: AI Agents & Intelligent Systems
Extend the open-source Bifrost gateway with a practical feature that solves a real problem for developers or gateway operators. This could include a plugin, provider integration, caching or routing capability, user interface, or developer tool.

The solution must use supported extension points, work with a standard Bifrost installation, and include clear setup instructions, documentation, and tests. The final contribution should be suitable for consideration as an upstream open-source pull request.
